title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 183 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 183 - Penalty shall not Prejudice any other Right of Filing No penalty imposed on a person under this Part shall be without prejudice the right of any liability for which such person is or may be liable under this Act or any other law for the time being in force. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail.
